sections.title: <is-date-field>
sections.lede: Campo editable por secciones (DateField de MUI X). Cada sección es un spinbutton: flechas, dígitos, izquierda/derecha, Retroceso. El orden lo decide el locale.

blocks.html:
<is-date-field id="df" label="Fecha" value="2026-07-30" locale="es" clearable></is-date-field>
          <is-date-field label="Date" value="2026-07-30" locale="en-US" clearable></is-date-field>

<is-time-field label="Hora 24 h" value="14:05" hour24 locale="es"></is-time-field>
          <is-time-field label="Time" value="14:05" ampm locale="en-US"></is-time-field>
          <is-time-field label="Con segundos" value="14:05:30" hour24 seconds locale="es"></is-time-field>
<is-date-time-field id="dtf" label="Fecha y hora" value="2026-07-30T09:30" locale="es" clearable></is-date-time-field>

<is-date-field label="Requerido" required locale="es"></is-date-field>
          <is-date-field label="Min 2026-08-01" value="2026-07-15" min="2026-08-01" locale="es"></is-date-field>
          <is-date-field label="Solo lectura" value="2026-07-30" readonly locale="es"></is-date-field>
